Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center, EDSA cor. Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City www.dilg.gov.ph DILG OPINION No. 94 s. 2022 15 September 2022 MR. ROSAURO OLIVER NONATO Barangay 747 Zone 81, Manila Dear Mr. Nonato: This has reference to the Resolution promulgated by the Commission on Elections (COMELEC) in case docketed as EAC No. 054-2019-B, which has attained finality' last 24 February 2022, with the corresponding Entry of Judgment2 also made on the same day. The dispositive portion of the COMELEC En Banc Resolution, provided: "WHEREFORE, premises considered, the Motion for Reconsideration filed by Respondent-Appellee Rosaurio Olivar Nonato is hereby DENIED. The First Division Resolution dated 29 January 2020 is hereby AFFIRMED. Accordingly, the Barangay Board of Canvassers of Barangay 747, Zone 81 , Manila is hereby directed to RECONVENE within five (5) days from receipt hereof, upon due notice to all concerned, to PREPARE a new Certificate of Canvass of Votes and Proclamation of Winning Candidates and PROCLAIM Petitioner-Appellant LIBERTY M. VALIDO, as the duly-elected Punong Barangay of Barangay 747, Zone 81, Manila in connection with the May 14, 2018 Barangay Elections. [emphasis supplied] Let a copy of this Resolution be given to the Department of Interior and Local Government, the Sangguniang Panlungsod of Manila, the Sangguniang Barangay of 747, Zone 81 , Manila and the Election Officer of District V, Manila. SO ORDERED." Correspondingly, a Certificate of Canvass of Votes and Proclamation of Winning Candidates for Punong Barangay and Kagawad was issued on 26 May 2022 by the Barangay Board of Canvassers of Barangay 747 of the City of Manila. The subject document showed that Liberty M. Valido obtained One Hundred Nineteen (119) votes, and by this reason, the Barangay Board of Canvassers has proclaimed her the winning candidate as Punong Barangay of Barangay 747, City of Manila. 1 Liberty M. Valido vs. Rosauro Olivar Nonato, EAC No. 054-2019-B, Certificate of Finality. 2 Liberty M. Valido vs. Rosauro Olivar Nonato, EAC No. 054-2019-B, Entry of Judgment. Matino, Mahusay at Maasahan" Trunkline No.: 8876-34-54

However, reportedly, despite the Notice issued by the COMELEC that Ms. Valido is the duly elected Punong Barangay, you are is still occupying the subject position. Since Liberty Valido was already proclaimed by the Barangay Board of Canvassers as the duly elected Punong Barangay of Barangay 747 of the City of Manila, it is but proper that she should immediately assume said Office and discharge the duties and functions appurtenant to said position. Should you insist on occupying the position of Punong Barangay despite notice and proclamation by the Barangay Board of Canvassers of Ms. Valido, you may be opening yourself to possible violation of Article 177 of the Revised Penal Code, which states: "Ad. 177. Usurpation of authority or official functions. — Any person who shall knowingly and falsely represent himself to be an officer, agent or representative of any department or agency of the Philippine Govemment or of any foreign govemment, or who, under pretense of official position, shall perform any act pertaining to any person in authority or public officer of the Philippine Govemment or any foreign govemment, or any agency thereof, without being lawfully entitled to do so, shall suffer the penalty of prision correccional in its minimum and medium periods. " If you have legal basis where you hinge your continued assumption to office, you are hereby advised to file the appropriate action in court. Should you obtain a favorable action, rest assured that the Department will assist you in the implementation thereof. Pending such favorable action, we reiterate that you vacate said post to give way for the assumption of Ms. Valido. We are hoping for your full cooperation on this matter. Very truly yours, BY AUTHORITY OF THE SECRETARY: GAN Underse tary for Local Governmen OUSLG/MLl/LLLS-LRALLD/sbl/clp MARIA LOURDES L. AGUSTIN, CESO Ill Regional Director, DILG-NCR Annex Building, Sugar Center Compound North Ave, Diliman, Quezon City Page 2 of 2
